hybrid.score_normalization: min-max over all chunks, per query and per retriever

evaluation.primary_metric: exact: normalized reference answer is a whole-token substring of a retrieved chunk
evaluation.answer_normalization: NFKD, accents stripped, lowercase, non-alphanumerics to spaces, whitespace collapsed
evaluation.soft_metric: token recall: share of the answer's non-stopword tokens found in one retrieved chunk
evaluation.significance_test: exact McNemar test on per-question hit@5 (exact)
